_comment: Example site file for one household. Copy it OUTSIDE the repo (it holds your names and addresses), edit it, and point WINTV_SITE at it in vm/local.env. make-iso.sh installs it as C:\ProgramData\WinTV\apps.json, merged over shell/apps.default.json (see its _comment). "setup" is used when building the answer file: Windows display language, regional format, keyboards (input locales), time zone and home location (GeoID). Edge can only be removed when the region is in the EEA (D-5); this example is Ireland.
